item.title: HP says RAM and storage now make up 35% of PC component costs
item.description: Memory prices are insane, and it’s not just hurting consumers — PC makers have to deal with this crap, too. According to HP’s quarterly earnings call yesterday, the company is now spending approximately 35 percent of its PC bill of materials (that is, the price of all the parts in a computer) on RAM and storage.
